title: Electron stable releases
notes: Research snapshot identifies Electron 45.0.0 release on 2026-10-20; selected initial baseline, not an indefinite version pin.

title: Electron versioning and release timelines
notes: Latest three stable major versions are supported; plan requires ongoing supported-major/security updates.

title: Electron globalShortcut API
notes: Portal shortcut support and registration behavior; desktop identity and runtime failure/conflicts require validation.

title: Electron security checklist
notes: Context isolation, sandboxing, IPC sender validation, navigation and external-content controls.

title: Electron process sandboxing
notes: Renderer sandbox boundary; not a substitute for the separate untrusted Node extension sandbox.

title: Electron BrowserWindow API source documentation
notes: Wayland limitations on ordinary client positioning, focus and related window control; companion capabilities require testing.

title: Electron safeStorage API source documentation
notes: Linux backend selection and basic_text fallback; persistent secrets must require an OS-backed backend.

title: Electron utilityProcess API source documentation
notes: Trusted background process mechanism for storage and workflow execution; not the untrusted plugin boundary.

title: Electron rebuild
notes: Rebuild trusted native SQLite addon for the exact packaged Electron ABI.

title: Electron autoUpdater API
notes: No built-in Linux auto-updating support; initial releases use normal Debian package installation.

title: Electron Forge Debian maker
notes: Selected .deb packaging mechanism; native/system integration files and disabled service require package tests.

title: Electron Forge Vite plugin
notes: Plugin documented as experimental; plan selects explicit Vite/esbuild build before Forge packaging.

title: React Flow documentation
notes: Visual graph editing foundation; graph execution semantics and accessibility of custom nodes remain Linuxcast responsibilities.

title: Playwright ElectronApplication API
notes: Electron UI/process test support; does not replace real compositor/input-device validation.

title: SQLite FTS5 extension
notes: Local full-text candidate retrieval; ranking and source-content preservation are application design decisions.

title: Node.js permission-model documentation
notes: Defense-in-depth permission controls; not treated as the untrusted extension security boundary.

title: Bubblewrap source and documentation
notes: Namespace/mount sandbox construction primitives; Linuxcast must define policy and fail closed if required isolation cannot be applied.

title: GNOME 48 developer release notes
notes: GNOME 48 global-shortcut portal support and desktop generation context.

title: XDG GlobalShortcuts portal
notes: Session-based global shortcut registration/permission protocol.

title: XDG Clipboard portal
notes: Clipboard support extends RemoteDesktop/InputCapture sessions; not a universal clipboard-history permission API.

title: XDG RemoteDesktop portal
notes: Consented remote-input sessions and input-emulation path; grant/revocation behavior must be tested.

title: XDG Screenshot portal
notes: User-mediated screenshot capture API.

title: XDG ScreenCast portal
notes: User-mediated capture/session protocol for supported capture features.

title: libei documentation
notes: Input-emulation client/server mechanism used with compatible desktop permissions; not arbitrary Wayland access.

title: Desktop Entry specification
notes: Application metadata, visibility, actions and launch semantics; Exec is not passed to a shell.

title: GIO AppInfo launch
notes: Platform application launch adapter selected over hand-built shell execution.

title: XDG Base Directory specification
notes: Config/data/cache/state/runtime placement, honoring environment values and specified fallbacks.

title: Desktop Application Autostart specification
notes: Explicit per-user startup preference; unrelated to enabling privileged capture.

title: Extended Window Manager Hints specification
notes: X11 window control/interoperability; not a native Wayland control API.

title: org.freedesktop.login1 D-Bus API
notes: Session/seat state and device-controller semantics; Linuxcast must not force takeover of the compositor's session controller.

title: MPRIS specification
notes: Desktop media player control protocol.

title: systemd 257 execution environment controls
notes: Debian-compatible service hardening; exact input-device/capability interactions require runtime tests.

title: systemd 257 resource control
notes: Cgroup resource and device policy primitives; required limits are selected product policy.

title: Polkit documentation
notes: Authorization for narrowly scoped input-service administration.

title: pkexec documentation
notes: Administrative execution context/caller identity; fixed helper actions only, never general root commands.

title: Linux kernel uinput documentation
notes: Userspace virtual input device mechanism; device lifetime and recovery require actual tests.

title: libevdev documentation
notes: Selected evdev event/forwarding library for dedicated input worker.

title: libevdev SYN_DROPPED handling
notes: Resynchronize device state after dropped events, clear typed-trigger inference and avoid reconstructing committed text.

title: libevdev initialization and device lifetime
notes: File descriptor and grab lifecycle; supervisor must not retain duplicate grab-owning descriptors after handoff.

title: libevdev uinput devices
notes: Virtual device creation/destruction and identity behavior.

title: libxkbcommon documentation
notes: Keyboard map/state processing; not proof of committed application text or protected-field status.

title: libxkbcommon compose API
notes: Compose-state support and limitations relevant to raw-key snippet matching.

title: Espanso Linux installation
notes: Related text-expander platform constraints; evidence for investigation, not an implementation dependency or parity claim.

title: GNOME Shell extension development
notes: Bundled companion structure and explicit Shell-version compatibility.

title: KWin 6.3.6 data-control implementation
notes: Versioned source confirms zwlr_data_control_manager_v1 baseline rather than assuming newer ext-data-control.

title: KWin 6.3.6 scripting workspace API
notes: Window enumeration, active window and work-area API basis for fixed script operations.

title: KWin 6.3.6 window API
notes: Geometry/maximization API basis; compositor-specific behavior remains an integration test gate.

title: KWin 6.3.6 scripting implementation
notes: Outbound asynchronous callDBus mechanism; helper-owned bounded NextCommand transport is proposed, not already tested.

title: Mutter 48 selection implementation
notes: Clipboard selection ownership notifications used by optional GNOME companion.

title: GNOME Shell 48 StClipboard API
notes: Clipboard MIME/content access in Shell companion; transfer races and limits require implementation.

title: Mutter 48 display API
notes: Window/focus API basis for companion integration.

title: keyd keyboard remapping daemon
notes: Existing evdev/uinput remapping pattern; no claim that Linuxcast inherits its implementation or security properties.

title: Kanata Linux setup
notes: Existing Linux remapper device-access/setup patterns; Linuxcast instead uses a fixed opt-in supervisor with no broad input-group grant.

title: SQLite Online Backup API
notes: Consistent snapshot backup of a live database; plan rejects copying a database file while ignoring WAL state.

title: SQLite Write-Ahead Logging
notes: Local-filesystem requirement, WAL lifetime/checkpointing and documented WAL-reset fix in SQLite 3.51.3; packaged runtime version must be checked.

title: SQLite synchronous pragma
notes: Durability modes; FULL is the selected initial content/checkpoint policy, subject to explicit measured review.

title: rage: Rust implementation of age
notes: Maintained Rust age implementation, standard passphrase encryption and interoperable library/CLI format; selected for portable backups.

title: age Rust crate API
notes: Passphrase/streaming APIs and interoperability. Inspected 0.12.1 documentation explicitly calls pre-1.0 APIs beta; exact version/toolchain and security review are required at bootstrap.

title: age scrypt Recipient API
notes: Public work-factor control for standard age passphrase encryption; plan selects factor 18 as a resource/security default.

title: age scrypt Identity API
notes: Maximum accepted work-factor control and denial-of-service considerations for untrusted encrypted files; plan selects maximum 20.

title: Rust regex crate
notes: Finite-automata regular-expression implementation; selected with pattern/input bounds and no backtracking-engine fallback.

title: Sharp image processing documentation
notes: Selected Sharp/libvips image-transform family; exact version/native ABI, license and parser-security gates remain implementation work.

title: pdf-lib documentation
notes: Pure-JavaScript PDF creation/modification and split/merge basis; selected for contained assembly jobs.

title: Mozilla PDF.js
notes: PDF parsing/rendering foundation; Linuxcast must disable document scripts/eval/external access and validate isolation.

title: LibreOffice startup parameters
notes: Headless conversion and writable profile requirements; optional installed-tool adapter uses a disposable sandbox profile and must test the detected Debian version.

title: Speech Dispatcher
notes: Local speech synthesis service/library; selected optional installed-service adapter with unavailable state when absent.
